'''Gavin''' (Japanese: '''ガロン''' ''Gallon'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG127|From Brags to Riches]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] from [[Ganga Town]], who competed in the [[Double Battle]] rounds of the [[Ever Grande Conference]].

Gavin was facing [[Morrison]] in the Tournament. Gavin sent out his {{p|Machamp}} and {{p|Marowak}} to face off against Morrison's {{p|Growlithe}} and {{p|Gligar}}. The {{pkmn|battle}} appeared even at first, but then Gavin gained the upper hand. Morrison refused to let that get him down, however, and he soon used his Gligar's {{m|Guillotine}} to knock out Machamp but soon after that, Marowak defeated Growlithe with {{m|Bone Club}}.

Once again, Morrison found himself at a disadvantage when Marowak froze one of Gligar's wings with {{m|Ice Beam}}. In a seemingly desperate move, he told Gligar to charge toward Marowak. The Fly Scorpion Pokémon used {{m|Iron Tail}} and defeated Marowak. Because of his loss, Gavin was eliminated from the Ever Grande Conference.
